title: The firſt article of the diuinity of the Sonne.

segments.text:
VVE beleue that Ieſus Chriſt concernynge hys diuine nature is the onelye ſonne of god béegotten from euerlaſtynge •nd not made, one withe the father in •ubſtaunce, coeternall and conſubſtan
•iall, equall to God his father in all thinges and euerye where.
